title: Tiny CLIP Dual-Encoder Vision-Language Model
description: A multimodal dual-encoder aligning vision and text representations: convolutional patch stem with cls_token and ViT block for images, learned embedding and causal transformer block with gather_token for text, QuickGELU projection heads, L2 normalization, and scaled dot-product similarity.
reference: Architecture follows Radford et al. 2021, "Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision" (CLIP, arXiv:2103.00020); parameter count checked against plain PyTorch: vision (img_stem 1,568, img_cls 32, img_pos 2,080, img_block 12,704, img_proj 2,048; vision total = 18,432) + text (text_emb 16,384, text_pos 1,024, text_block 49,984, text_proj 4,096; text total = 71,488); total checked via model.parameters() = 89,920.
